title: Seed amount is not asserted against the pot delta at the script level — a 0/short seed would pass silently if the helper floor were misconfigured
description: The script measures usdcOut = USDC.balanceOf(newMinter) - potBefore and logs it, but never require()s that the measured delta is > 0 or >= minUsdcOut at the script level. The only enforcement is inside SeedSwapHelper (usdcReceived < minUsdcOut reverts). minUsdcOut is env-overridable (MIN_USDC_OUT) and could be set to 0 by an operator (the DEFAULT is 47e6, but vm.envOr lets a 0 override through with no floor-on-the-floor guard). The script's success/postflight path treats any outcome as success and proceeds to retire the old contract and (in broadcast) persist progress + rewrite addresses. There is also no script-level require that minUsdcOut and minBptWei are themselves non-zero before broadcasting, despite the repo's Configuration Safety gate explicitly requiring such guards.
impact: Defense-in-depth gap rather than a live exploit (the helper floor caught it this run). If MIN_USDC_OUT were overridden to 0 (or the helper path changed), a sandwiched/degenerate swap could seed near-zero USDC and the cutover would still report success, compounding the unfunded-pot problem in BMR-M-01. The migration would look complete while the new minter holds ~0 USDC.
attackPath: Operator (mis)sets MIN_USDC_OUT=0 via env, OR the helper floor is later removed/changed.
A sandwiched or degenerate swap seeds near-zero USDC.
Script's postflight treats any outcome as success, retires the old minter and persists progress / rewrites addresses.
Migration looks complete while the new minter holds ~0 USDC, compounding the unfunded-pot problem in BMR-M-01.
recommendation: Add require(minUsdcOut > 0 && minBptWei > 0, "slippage floors unset") at the top of run() (mainnet branch), and require(usdcOut >= minUsdcOut, "seed below floor") as a script-level post-condition after _seedFromBpt, so the script refuses to retire/persist on a degenerate seed.
evidence: script/ReplaceBatchNFTMinter.s.sol L394 usdcOut computed but never asserted; L257 minUsdcOut = vm.envOr("MIN_USDC_OUT", DEFAULT) with no require(minUsdcOut > 0). Fork run (block ~25207560) seeded 50418020 (helper floor held), so impact unrealized this run.
